decision.explanation: The vector projection is (a·b)/(b·b) times b. Since a·b = 2+2+9 = 13 and b·b = 3, the projection is ⟨13/3,-13/3,13/3⟩.

after.name: Question 1
after.problem: Let $a=⟨2,-2,9⟩$ and $b=⟨1,-1,1⟩.$ Find the vector projection of $a$ onto $b.$
after.worked_solution:
Using the formula for the vector projection, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,a & =\frac{a\cdot b}{b\cdot b}b \\  & =\frac{{a}_{x}{b}_{x}+{a}_{y}{b}_{y}+{a}_{z}{b}_{z}}{{b}_{x}^{2}+{b}_{y}^{2}+{b}_{z}^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{2\cdot 1+(-2)\cdot (-1)+9\cdot 1}{{1}^{2}+(-1)^{2}+{1}^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{13}{3}⟨1,-1,1⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{13}{3},-\frac{13}{3},\frac{13}{3}⟩.\end{aligned}
$$

content.problem: Let $a=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 3 \\ 3\sqrt{2}\end{aligned}]$ and $b=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}].$ Find the vector projection of $b$ onto $a.$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{a}\,b & =\frac{a\cdot b}{a\cdot a}a \\  & =\frac{{a}_{x}{b}_{x}+{a}_{y}{b}_{y}+{a}_{z}{b}_{z}}{{a}_{x}^{2}+{a}_{y}^{2}+{a}_{z}^{2}}a \\  & =\frac{6\cdot 3+3\cdot 1+3\sqrt{2}\cdot 0}{{6}^{2}+{3}^{2}+(3\sqrt{2})^{2}}a \\  & =\frac{21}{63}⟨6,3,3\sqrt{2}⟩ \\  & =\frac{1}{3}⟨6,3,3\sqrt{2}⟩ \\  & =⟨2,1,\sqrt{2}⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
